name: Chori Co., Ltd.
summary: Chori Co., Ltd. engages in textiles, chemicals, and machinery business in China and internationally. The company offers fibers, textiles, and garments, including synthetic fiber intermediates, polyester fibers, and nylon threads; fabrics used in casual wear, sportswear, Middle Eastern garments, and various other materials; hygienic and lifestyle-related materials and construction materials; polyester yarn and fabrics used on car seats; lab coats, uniforms, suits, and clothing materials; men's apparel, women's apparel, and unisex apparel; and sportswear, fitness wear, golf wear, and innerwear.
